description: Strong position: Evidence suppression with Supreme Court backing

input.problem_statement: Client charged with drug trafficking. All evidence obtained through illegal wiretap without court authorization. Supreme Court precedent mandates exclusion.

procedural_steps: file motion to suppress all wiretap evidence
challenge any derivative evidence (fruit of poisonous tree)
if granted, prosecution has no case - move to dismiss
evidence_needed: list of all evidence derived from wiretap
argument_titles: Illegal wiretap violates constitutional privacy rights

validation_notes: Should generate 3-4 very strong arguments (avg 82-94), no settlement (position extremely strong), success probability 80-92%, emphasize constitutional violation and fruit of poisonous tree doctrine, likely complete dismissal if motion granted.
